CustomObject.label: Grid Edit Log
CustomObject.description: The audit trail for grids that have Log Changes turned on: one entry for each field changed, and one for each record created, deleted or used in an action. An entry is saved together with its change, so if the entry cannot be saved, neither is the change. The Rowhouse Grid User permission set lets users create entries and read their own, but never edit or delete them. Created By and Created Date show who made the change and when. Entries are kept forever unless a period is chosen on the Grid Admin tab; a nightly clean-up then deletes older ones.
